modes.sentence: Jarvis neither learns nor uses this. What it knows is kept, not deleted, and comes back when you switch it on.

card_cases.name: Health
card_cases.text:
Turn Health back on for answers? Jarvis will use your Health facts again.

Facts that count as sensitive are still kept on screen and not read aloud, and new ones still wait for your yes unless "Also remember sensitive topics automatically" is on.

Health would become: Learn and use.
If you say no: nothing about your topics changes.

card_cases.name: Money
card_cases.text:
Turn Money back on for answers? Jarvis will use your Money facts again.

Facts that count as sensitive are still kept on screen and not read aloud, and new ones still wait for your yes unless "Also remember sensitive topics automatically" is on.

This was asked after Jarvis read outside text (an email, a web page, a file). Only say yes if it is what you want.

Money would become: Use, but don't learn.
If you say no: nothing about your topics changes.
